policy: Pairs are matched-input, deterministic, defined-behavior C/Python programs. C must have no undefined behavior, no signed overflow (modulo checksums used), no unbounded loops. expected_stdout values were verified with the HOST clang-18/gcc + CPython toolchains independently of the container pipeline; both sides must match exactly.

pairs.concept: sorting algorithm / insertion sort (modulo checksum: C signed overflow is UB)
